title: Git
goal: Record and inspect a small change safely.
explanation: Git stores a history of commits. Your working tree contains edits, and the staging area selects what goes into the next commit.
Use git status and git diff before staging. After staging, inspect git diff --cached so the commit contains only the intended change.
Keep credentials, environment files and generated dependencies out of commits. A .gitignore rule does not remove a secret already tracked; exposed credentials need rotation.
code:
git status
git diff
git add index.html styles.css
git diff --cached
git commit -m "Add responsive contact page"
exercise: Create a practice repository, edit one heading, inspect the diff and commit the change.
hint: Read the staged diff before committing. Use a test folder without secrets.

quiz.question: Which command shows staged changes?
quiz.explanation: The cached diff compares the staged snapshot with the last commit.
